Kakeibo M5b test report

A hands-on test of M5b, the onboarding guide: the welcome tour and first-run setup, the Getting started checklist, tips, (?) explanations, coach marks on every main screen and the Help Center, plus two PRD features found missing along the way (refunds and the month start day). Tested on a real phone and by the automated suite; every bug found was fixed and re-checked on the phone.

Still open

  • Pillar quiz and demo data. FR-96 (P1) and FR-98 (P2) weren't built.
  • Partial first month. FR-17 (starting mid-month with pro-rated amounts) isn't built; the FAQ explains how to plan a part month by hand.
  • Your phone. A Rs 500 Wants refund was added as a test. Delete it in Spends if you like.

Not covered by this run

  • Turning reminders on, or setting a PIN, from inside the first-run setup (both reuse flows tested in M5; widget tests cover the steps).
  • Changing the month start day on the phone, which would move your test month.
  • The new screens in dark mode, and a full TalkBack run of the tour.
  • The tour on a brand-new install (the update showed it because this build hadn't seen it before).

Automated tests

  • flutter analyze: no issues.
  • flutter test: 109 passed, 8 new in M5b.
  • Month start day: an untouched first month moves at once; a month in use keeps its dates and a transition period follows; a very short transition runs on into the next month.
  • Refunds: a refund from quick add lowers its pillar, and editing it into an expense flips it back.
  • Widgets: the first run goes through the tour, Skip, the setup steps and records the tour as done without turning on reminders; the checklist counts and labels items; (?) explains the daily allowance; Help search finds the refund answer and opens the FAQ.
